summary:
• Technical Manager with over 16 years of experience in directing large engagement including complex Program/Project
Management, Delivery Management, People Management, Telecom service delivery, Service assurance Processes SME
across wired and wireless telecom deliveries.
• Extensive background in UC Products (UCaaS) Unified Communications as a Service, Cisco Hosted Collaboration System
(HCS), Cisco Unified Communication IP telephony (IPT), Hosted Contact Center (CCaaS) & Microsoft Products (MS TDR,
Operator Connect, MS Teams Phone Mobile).
• Service Delivery & Operations across several Vodafone Enterprise product suite (Unified Comms, International Carrier
Services, RCS & Mobility etc.)
• Global Exposure: Delivery & Deployment of complex services across regions such as Vodafone India, Vodafone UK
Group & Vodafone local operating companies worldwide.
• Experience in Managing teams in multiple Telecom domains like 2G,3G, 4G, RCS, and UC
• Responsible overall Network team’s SLA and KPI reporting to senior management on monthly basis.
